response.original_title: Spectre: To the End of the Earth
response.overview: 1000 miles, 200+ kgs, 65 days, 3 mates, 1 mountain. Unsupported, using snow-kites to travel great distance, with massive loads at speeds up to 60 kmph this is the epic tale of Leo Houlding and teams daring dream to reach the summit of the most remote mountain on Earth; The Spectre, Antarctica.
